questions.explanation:
Terminal commands
`python -m venv .venv` — Prints the active Python interpreter's version; your platform may use `python3` or `py` instead.
`python -m pip install requests` — Shows pip attached to that interpreter; `python -m pip` makes the selected Python explicit.
`python -m pip freeze > requirements.txt` — Shows pip attached to that interpreter; `python -m pip` makes the selected Python explicit.
